verdict.rationale: The pack never shows the firm publishing on jurisdiction-specific instruments such as UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE. Its equity-compensation material covers US-style instruments (ISOs/NSOs, RSUs, phantom stock), and its global footprint (Beijing, São Paulo, Singapore offices) and Knowledge Hub are not shown to cover any non-US market's startup rules.
